text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews and recommend two public member candidates to City Council for appointment to the CreateTO Board. One of the two public members will be recommended for appointment as Chair.

City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2025 adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following public members: Bruce Davis; and Allison Mendes a. to the CreateTO Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on December 19, 2029, and until successors are appointed; and b. to the Boards of Directors of Build Toronto and the Toronto Port Lands Company, at the pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on December 19, 2027, and until successors are appointed. 2. City Council re-appoint Sheerin Sheikh: a. to the CreateTO Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office starting on March 29, 2026, and ending on December 19, 2029, and until a successor is appointed; and b. to the Boards of Directors of Build Toronto and the Toronto Port Lands Company, at the pleasure of Council, for a term of office starting on March 29, 2026, and ending on December 19, 2027,…
